metadata.description: AI-powered secure, autonomous development workflow. RePPITS methodology with configurable compliance gates — enable any of HIPAA, HITRUST, ISO 27001, SOC 2 (healthcare is one aspect).

plugins.name: loobster
plugins.description: Run /run for the full Research → Propose → Plan → Implement → Test → Secure workflow with healthcare compliance gates, or invoke any phase as a standalone slash command. /loop runs a continuous goal-loop over an optimizable RICE-scored backlog. /signals is a shared team hub where any loop emits observations and any loop consumes them, with a dynamic dashboard. /team-setup wires a repo for the team layer in one command: fleet dashboard on GitHub Pages, signals hub, compliance-gated on repo visibility. Adaptive risk-tiered gates, a bounded autonomous fix loop, resumable Tasks (/resume), parallel sub-issues, and built-in token compression (zero-install, with an optional headroom upgrade). /secure runs your enabled compliance frameworks (any of HIPAA, HITRUST, ISO 27001, SOC 2) against your diff and separates code-verifiable findings from organizational controls.
